svg.aria-label: Animated demo: build indexes from the CLI, ask a grounded question and get a cited answer, then an out-of-domain question that is refused; the Streamlit chat answers the same question in Bangla

g.text: $ python scripts/ask.py "How many days of annual leave?"
Every permanent employee is entitled to 20 days of annual
$ python scripts/ask.py "What is the capital of France?"
I could not find the answer in the provided documents.
relevance gate blocked · no citation invented
